node.title: Re: keys %{$hash->{$href}} adds $href to the hash if it doesnt exist?
node.author: Discipulus
node.doctext:
Hello [nikmit],

it's not a case of autovivification?

It is explained in [DOC://perlref|perlref] and for more informations see [id://691557] and [id://1070109] and [https://perlmaven.com/autovivification]

On CPAN there is [metacpan://autovivification|a pragma] to disable it if unwanted.

PS [DOC://exists|exists] fixes your snippet: if (exists $href->{cow} and keys %{$href->{cow}}) { # no cow

L*

There are no rules, there are no thumbs..
Reinvent the wheel, then learn The Wheel; may be one day you reinvent one of THE WHEELS.
